description: Boot the application and enter the first run state.
Move and complete a grounded jump without invalid state.
Dash and resolve a one-way platform contact.
Generate a blade contact above the valid cut threshold.
Deflect a standard projectile without invalid player health.
Clear a wave and enter the draft state.
Select one legal draft choice and resume gameplay.

At one HP, trigger the real live Source void-fall rescue through semantic movement, retain its native evidence, verify a supported pre-rescue replay receipt, and explicitly refuse unsupported detached post-rescue void replay and mixed-capsule seeking.

evidence.artifact: An ephemeral sealed Ghost V3 capsule, including 60-tick canonical keyframes, a one-HP semantic void-fall rescue, its native world.void-rescue fact, a supported pre-rescue detached replay receipt, and explicit refusal of unsupported detached post-rescue void replay and mixed-capsule seeking.
evidence.artifactRetention: The browser proof verifies the capsule and receipts in its isolated test profile; it does not retain a checked-in release artifact.
